title: JESUS SAID THIS ABOUT HIS OWN FAMILY—THE SHOCKING TRUTH MOST CHRISTIANS IGNORE!
paragraphs: JESUS SAID THIS ABOUT HIS OWN FAMILY—THE SHOCKING TRUTH MOST CHRISTIANS IGNORE!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, does Jesus really say that not everyone is part of His family? What did He mean when He said, ‘Whoever does the will of My Father is My brother and sister and mother’ in Matthew 12:46-50?”

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people assume that just because they believe in Jesus, they are automatically part of His family. But what if I told you that Jesus Himself set a clear condition for who truly belongs to Him?
🚨 The truth may shock you—but you cannot ignore it!

Today, we will break this down using Scripture, biblical history, and real-life application. You’ll discover:
✔️ Why Jesus seemingly distanced Himself from His earthly family
✔️ The true meaning of being a part of God’s family
✔️ The #1 requirement Jesus gave for being His brother, sister, or mother
💡 Are YOU truly part of God’s family, or have you just assumed you are?

THE TRUTH REVEALED – WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?
📖 Matthew 12:46-50 (KJV)
"While He yet talked to the people, behold, His mother and His brethren stood without, desiring to speak with Him. Then one said unto Him, Behold, Thy mother and Thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with Thee. But He answered and said unto him that told Him, Who is My mother? and who are My brethren? And He stretched forth His hand toward His disciples, and said, Behold My mother and My brethren! For whosoever shall do the will of My Father which is in heaven, the same is My brother, and sister, and mother."
🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
At first glance, it may seem like Jesus was rejecting His own earthly family—but that is NOT what He was doing! Instead, He was teaching a powerful spiritual truth that many people miss:

✅ 1. GOD’S FAMILY IS NOT ABOUT BLOOD—IT’S ABOUT OBEDIENCE!
Many people assume that being born into a Christian home makes them part of God’s family. But Jesus destroyed that false belief by saying that only those who do the will of the Father are truly His family.

📖 John 1:12 (KJV)
"But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name."

💡 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You are NOT automatically part of God’s family just because you go to church.
✔️ The true family of God is made up of those who receive Jesus AND obey Him.
✔️ Spiritual birth is greater than physical birth.
🚨 WARNING: Your last name, nationality, or religious background doesn’t matter—only your relationship with Jesus does!
💭 QUESTION: Have you truly been born into God’s family, or are you just claiming it?

✅ 2. JESUS WAS SHIFTING THE FOCUS TO THE SPIRITUAL FAMILY!
His earthly mother, Mary, and His siblings had a blood connection to Jesus, but He made it clear that spiritual obedience is greater than physical relationships.

📖 Luke 14:26 (KJV)
"If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Jesus is NOT saying to hate your family—but that following Him must be your first priority!
✔️ Many people refuse to follow Christ because of family traditions—but they are rejecting truth.
✔️ If you have to choose between pleasing your family and obeying God, choose GOD!
💡 MANY WILL BE LOST BECAUSE THEY FOLLOW FAMILY TRADITIONS INSTEAD OF GOD’S WORD!
🚨 Brother John, have you ever seen people reject truth because they don’t want to go against family tradition? It’s happening every day!

✅ 3. THIS IS A WAKE-UP CALL TO FALSE CONVERTS!
Jesus is telling us that just because we identify as ‘Christian’ does not mean we belong to Him. The question is simple:

📖 1 John 2:4 (KJV)
"He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
❌ You cannot say you know Jesus and live in disobedience!
❌ Saying “I love Jesus” is not enough—your life must prove it!
❌ The true family of God is not made up of churchgoers—it’s made up of disciples!
💡 QUESTION: If Jesus judged you RIGHT NOW, would He call you part of His family—or would He say, “I never knew you”?

✅ 4. MANY BELIEVE "ONCE A CHRISTIAN, ALWAYS A CHRISTIAN"—BUT THAT’S A LIE!
There are people who grew up in church, sang in the choir, and even served in ministry—but they were never truly born again! Jesus makes it clear that ONLY those who do the Father’s will are in His family.

📖 Matthew 7:21-23 (KJV)
"Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven. Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity."
🚨 MANY PEOPLE THINK THEY ARE SAVED—BUT JESUS DOESN’T KNOW THEM!

✅ 5. ARE YOU PART OF THE WORLD OR PART OF GOD’S FAMILY?
Many people today try to live half in the world and half in God’s kingdom. But Jesus makes it clear:

📖 James 4:4 (KJV)
"Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
❌ If you love sin more than God, you are NOT in His family.
❌ If you follow the world’s ways instead of Christ’s commands, you are NOT His disciple.
❌ If you compromise truth to fit in with the world, you are against God!
💡 YOU MUST CHOOSE: Are you in God’s family—or the world’s family?

✅ 6. YOUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD MUST BE GREATER THAN ANY EARTHLY RELATIONSHIP!
🚨 Many people miss heaven because they value earthly relationships over their relationship with Christ!

📖 Luke 9:62 (KJV)
"And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ If you hesitate to fully follow Jesus, you are unfit for the Kingdom!
✔️ If you let family pressure stop you from obeying Christ, you are choosing them over God!
✔️ True disciples are willing to lose everything for Jesus!
💡 WOULD YOU STILL FOLLOW JESUS IF IT COST YOU YOUR FAMILY, FRIENDS, OR EVEN YOUR LIFE?

WHY MOST CHURCHES IGNORE THIS TRUTH!
Jesus made it crystal clear that only those who do the will of the Father are part of His family. But today, most churches don’t teach this! Instead, they promote false teachings that keep people in deception.
🚨 WHY? BECAUSE TELLING THE TRUTH WOULD COST THEM FOLLOWERS!

❌ 1. MANY PASTORS PREACH A ‘FEEL-GOOD GOSPEL’ INSTEAD OF TRUE DISCIPLESHIP!
Most modern churches don’t talk about obedience to God because they’re afraid people will leave. Instead, they preach:

❌ “God loves you just the way you are—no need to change!”
❌ “Once saved, always saved—no matter what you do!”
❌ “Come to church, give your tithes, and that’s enough!”

🔥 BUT JESUS NEVER SAID THAT!
He said:

📖 Luke 6:46 (KJV)
"And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?"
💡 QUESTION: Is your faith based on what Jesus said—or what your church preaches?

❌ 2. MANY CHURCHES TEACH ‘RELIGION’ INSTEAD OF TRUE RELATIONSHIP!
A lot of people think they are in God’s family just because they:

❌ Go to church every Sunday
❌ Pray before meals
❌ Wear a cross necklace
🔥 BUT THESE THINGS DO NOT MAKE YOU A CHILD OF GOD!

📖 John 14:15 (KJV)
"If ye love me, keep my commandments."
💡 DO YOU LOVE JESUS ENOUGH TO OBEY HIM—OR JUST ENOUGH TO CALL YOURSELF A CHRISTIAN?

❌ 3. CHURCHES HAVE WATERED DOWN THE MESSAGE TO KEEP PEOPLE COMFORTABLE!
Many preachers today never talk about repentance, holiness, or obedience because they don’t want to offend anyone.
🚨 THEY PREACH COMFORTABLE SERMONS BECAUSE THEY WANT MORE MEMBERS—NOT MORE DISCIPLES!
🔥 BUT JESUS WARNED US ABOUT THIS!

📖 2 Timothy 4:3 (KJV)
"For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears."
💡 QUESTION: Are you listening to pastors who make you comfortable in sin—or teachers who convict you to change?

🔥 4. TRUE DISCIPLES FOLLOW JESUS—NOT MAN-MADE CHURCH SYSTEMS!
Jesus never told us to just sit in church once a week and call it Christianity. He commanded us to:

✔️ Deny ourselves daily (Luke 9:23)
✔️ Obey His commandments (John 14:15)
✔️ Live separate from the world (2 Corinthians 6:17)

🚨 BUT MOST CHURCHES TEACH NONE OF THIS! Instead, they:
❌ Tell people to “just believe” and they’re saved!
❌ Encourage entertainment instead of real worship!
❌ Focus on making people feel good instead of making them holy!
🔥 TRUE FOLLOWERS OF JESUS DON’T JUST LISTEN TO SERMONS—THEY LIVE IN OBEDIENCE!
💡 QUESTION: Are you a disciple of Jesus—or just a churchgoer?

THE FINAL WARNING – YOU CANNOT STAY NEUTRAL!
Jesus has made it clear: Not everyone is part of His family. It doesn’t matter if you were raised in church, call yourself a Christian, or believe in God—if you do not do the will of the Father, you are NOT His!

🚨 THERE ARE ONLY TWO OPTIONS:
✔️ Obey Jesus and become part of His family
❌ Ignore His commands and be cast out

📖 Matthew 7:24-27 (KJV)
"Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock. And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock. And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You are either standing firm in obedience or building on sand with false religion!
✔️ Your works prove if you belong to God—or if you’re deceiving yourself.
✔️ One day, the storm (Judgment Day) will reveal who truly belongs to Jesus!
💡 WHICH HOUSE ARE YOU BUILDING—ON ROCK OR ON SAND?

🚨 JESUS WILL REJECT MANY WHO THOUGHT THEY WERE CHRISTIANS!
📖 Matthew 7:21-23 (KJV)
"Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven. Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity."

🚨 THINK ABOUT THIS:
❌ These people called Jesus “Lord”—but He rejected them!
❌ They did miracles in His name—but He didn’t know them!
❌ They thought they were saved—but they were LOST!
🔥 WHY? BECAUSE THEY DID NOT DO THE FATHER’S WILL!
💡 QUESTION: Will YOU hear “Well done, good and faithful servant”—or will Jesus say “Depart from Me” to you?

🔥 THIS MAY BE YOUR LAST WARNING!
The truth has been spoken. You cannot unread this or pretend you never heard it.

🚨 WHAT WILL YOU DO NOW?
❌ Ignore it and stay in deception?
✔️ Repent, obey Jesus, and truly become part of God’s family?

📖 Hebrews 3:15 (KJV)
"While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation."
🔥 THIS MAY BE YOUR LAST CHANCE TO CHOOSE!

🔥 PRAYER FOR TODAY – SURRENDER TO JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, open my eyes to the truth. Remove all deception from my life, and help me walk in Your Word alone. I choose to obey You and do the will of the Father. I surrender my heart completely to You—no more halfway commitment, no more religious deception. Make me a true disciple and a faithful member of Your family. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
